name: Buy prince ali rescue supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Ask Hassan how to help

evidence.note: Hassan sends you to the spymaster.

name: Get rescue instructions from Osman

evidence.note: Learn how to disguise Prince Ali and copy the key.

name: Get a wig from Ned and dye it yellow

evidence.note: Give Ned three balls of wool and use yellow dye on the wig.

name: Have Aggie make the skin paste

evidence.note: Give Aggie redberries, ash, flour and water. The model budgets the containers with the ingredients.

name: Get a clay impression of Lady Keli's key

evidence.note: Persuade Lady Keli to let you handle the key and take an impression in soft clay.

name: Make the bronze key at a furnace

evidence.note: Use the key print and a bronze bar at the furnace. The player casts the key in the current quest route.

name: Plan the break-in with Leela

evidence.note: Show Leela the disguise and key. She explains how to handle the guard.

name: Distract Joe, restrain Lady Keli and free Prince Ali

evidence.note: Give Joe three beers, tie up Lady Keli, unlock the cell and give Ali the disguise. Pass the jail guards without engaging them if possible.

name: Report the rescue to Hassan

evidence.note: Awards three quest points, 700 coins, 500 Smithing XP and 500 Crafting XP. Unlocks free gate passage and the Sorceress's Garden introduction.

name: Read the Shield of Arrav book and speak to Reldo

evidence.note: Talk to Reldo, find the book and ask him about the gangs.

name: Pay Baraek for the Phoenix Gang location

evidence.note: Commit to the Phoenix route and pay Baraek 20 coins for the location.

name: Ask Straven how to join the Phoenix Gang

evidence.note: Straven asks you to recover the intelligence report.

name: Defeat Jonny the Beard for the report

evidence.note: Defeat Jonny in the Blue Moon Inn and take his report.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Give Straven the report and take the shield half

evidence.note: Show Straven the report, collect the storeroom key and search the chest.

name: Give Haig the Phoenix shield half

evidence.note: Give your partner the weapon storeroom key and show the curator your shield half.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The partner has received the storeroom key and the curator issued the certificate halves.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Arrange a Black Arm Gang partner.

name: Speak to Charlie and agree to help Katrine

evidence.note: Ask Charlie about the alley, then join Katrine's route.

name: Receive the Phoenix storeroom key from a partner

evidence.note: Arrange for a Phoenix Gang partner to give you a key.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A Phoenix Gang partner provides the key.

name: Defeat the Weaponsmaster and take two crossbows

evidence.note: Use the key to enter, defeat the Weaponsmaster, collect two crossbows and leave the storeroom.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Weaponsmaster is defeated and two crossbows have been collected.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Give Katrine two crossbows and collect her shield half

evidence.note: Give Katrine the crossbows, then search the upstairs cupboard.

name: Give Haig the Black Arm shield half

evidence.note: The curator gives two matching certificate halves.

name: Exchange Phoenix and Black Arm certificates

evidence.note: Exchange one half with the partner and combine the two types.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A partner has provided a matching certificate half.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Arrange a Black Arm Gang partner.

name: Exchange Black Arm and Phoenix certificates

evidence.note: Exchange one half with the partner and combine the two types.

planned_outcome.success_condition: A partner has provided a matching certificate half.

name: Give the completed certificate to King Roald

evidence.note: Awards one quest point, 600 coins and the build 242 completion lamp.

name: Buy below ice mountain supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Ask Willow about her excavation

evidence.note: Requires 16 quest points. Willow asks you to recruit her crew.

name: Ask Checkal to join the crew

evidence.note: Checkal asks you to show strength first.

name: Learn the Flex emote from Atlas

evidence.note: Speak to Atlas and complete his strength exercises.

name: Flex for Checkal

evidence.note: Perform the Flex emote and recruit Checkal.

name: Find out what Marley wants

evidence.note: Marley asks for a steak sandwich.

name: Learn the steak sandwich recipe

evidence.note: Ask the cook at the Blue Moon Inn how to make the sandwich.

name: Make a steak sandwich and give it to Marley

evidence.note: Slice the bread, add cooked meat and hand it to Marley.

name: Give Burntof an ale and beat him at rock-paper-scissors

evidence.note: Give Burntof an Asgarnian ale and play until you win.

name: Meet the crew at the excavation

evidence.note: Speak to Willow and enter the excavation after the crew opens the passage.

name: Overcome the Ancient Guardian

evidence.note: Defeat the guardian or mine the four pillars at level 10 Mining.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Finish the excavation cutscene

evidence.note: Awards one quest point, 2,000 coins and 1,200 Mining XP. The Ruins of Camdozaal and steak sandwich recipe become available.

name: Buy sleeping giants supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Approach the hill giant and speak to Kovac

evidence.note: Interact with the giant at the cave entrance, then speak to Kovac.

name: Repair the polishing wheel

evidence.note: Repair the wheel with a hammer, two oak logs, five nails and one piece of raw wool.

name: Repair the grindstone

evidence.note: Use a chisel on the damaged grindstone.

name: Repair the trip hammer

evidence.note: Use one oak log and five nails with a hammer.

name: Set the sword mould and pour the trial sword

evidence.note: Get a commission from Kovac. Select the mould and fill the crucible with the trial metal from the supply crate.

name: Cool the mould and take out the preform

evidence.note: Use ice gloves or cool the mould using the bucket and waterfall on site, then pick up the preform with empty hands. The time includes collecting the water.

name: Forge the commission sword

evidence.note: Work at the trip hammer, grindstone and polishing wheel while the metal is in each machine's temperature range.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The trial sword has been finished to Kovac's standard.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Reheat or cool the preform as needed.

name: Give Kovac the finished sword

evidence.note: Awards one quest point and 6,000 Smithing XP. Unlocks repeat Giants' Foundry commissions.

name: Ask Abigale about the manor

evidence.note: Talk to Abigale in the south-east of Lumbridge Swamp.

name: Recover the front door key and enter the manor

evidence.note: Collect the nearby bucket. Use it on the rainwater barrel, search for the key and unlock the manor.

name: Solve the library clue and find the ruby key

evidence.note: Take the knife, examine the pink door, read the note and cut open the painting.

name: Light the candles and open the garden route

evidence.note: Take a tinderbox, light the candles and light the barrel fuse. Leave the room and climb through the damaged wall.

name: Follow the garden clue for the emerald key

evidence.note: Watch through the trees, read the note and solve its clue to obtain the emerald key.

name: Solve the fireplace gem sequence

evidence.note: Use the emerald key to continue, read the next clue and solve the gem puzzle inside the fireplace.

name: Defeat the mirror puzzle and confront the killer

evidence.note: Use the mirror to reflect the knives, watch the reveal, and use the killer's knife for the final dialogue scene.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The mirror puzzle and killer reveal are complete.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Watch the wardrobes for the next attack and try again.

name: Report to Mandy outside the manor

evidence.note: Awards one quest point, 600 Crafting XP and three uncut gems.

name: Ask Kangai Mau about the stolen totem

evidence.note: Kangai asks for his tribe's totem.

name: Move the address label and arrange delivery

evidence.note: Use the label from the north-eastern crate on Cromperty's teleport crate, then have the depot employee ship it.

name: Have Cromperty teleport you into the mansion

evidence.note: Ask to be teleported after the crate has been delivered.

name: Unlock the door and disarm the trapped staircase

evidence.note: Enter KURT, then use Investigate on the stairs before climbing.

name: Retrieve the totem from the upstairs chest

evidence.note: Open and search the chest.

name: Return the totem to Kangai Mau

evidence.note: Kangai grants 1 quest point, 1,775 Thieving XP and five cooked swordfish.

name: Buy hand in the sand supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Buy a beer from the Dragon Inn bartender

evidence.note: The bartender sells a beer for 2 GP.

name: Ask Bert about the hand in the sandpit

evidence.note: Receive the hand from Bert.

name: Give the Guard Captain a beer and show him the hand

evidence.note: The captain sends you to the Wizards' Guild.

name: Ring the guild bell and show Zavistic the hand

evidence.note: Zavistic asks you to investigate the altered hours.

name: Ask Bert for a copy of his rota

evidence.note: Bert supplies his rota.

name: Search Sandy's desk and pickpocket Sandy

evidence.note: Retry the pickpocket until Sandy's sand is obtained.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Retrieve Sandy's rota and successfully pickpocket sand.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time for pickpocket retries.

name: Compare the rotas with Bert and collect the scroll

evidence.note: Read both rotas and ask about the discrepancy.

name: Give Zavistic the scroll and get the recording orb

evidence.note: Talk to Zavistic at the bell after getting Bert's scroll.

name: Help Betty prepare the truth serum

evidence.note: Use the berries and vial to dye the lens, then use it from the doorway to focus light on the counter. Add Sandy's sand.

name: Dose Sandy's coffee and record his confession

evidence.note: Distract Sandy, add the serum, activate the orb and ask all the questions.

name: Report the confession and supply Zavistic's spell

evidence.note: Hand over the recording, five earth runes and a bucket of sand.

name: Ask Mazion about the wizard's remains

evidence.note: Reach Entrana with a permitted loadout and receive the wizard's head.

name: Give the wizard's head to Zavistic

evidence.note: Receive 1 quest point, 1,000 Thieving XP and 9,000 Crafting XP. Bert's daily bank delivery becomes available. The Wizards’ Guild rune shop also becomes available with guild access.

name: Give Zavistic a vial for his Port Sarim teleport

evidence.note: The optional quest teleport uses a separate empty vial from Betty's recipe.

name: Ask Bert to deliver sand to your bank

evidence.note: One manual delivery is modeled. Bert sends 84 buckets to the bank, giving the Ardougne diary credit.

name: Buy what lies below supplies

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Buy chaos talisman

evidence.note: Estimated main-account purchase budget.

name: Offer to recover Rat Burgiss's missing papers

evidence.note: Requires Rune Mysteries and 35 Runecraft. Rat supplies an empty folder.

name: Defeat five Outlaws and file the stolen papers

evidence.note: Pick up all five papers and put them into Rat's folder.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat five Outlaws and fill Rat's folder.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Give Rat the papers and collect his letter

evidence.note: Rat asks you to deliver his letter to Surok.

name: Deliver Rat's letter and receive Surok's wand

evidence.note: Hear Surok's request and take his diary and the metal wand.

name: Infuse the wand at the Chaos Altar

evidence.note: Use the metal wand with fifteen chaos runes. The altar can be reached via the Abyss, the Wilderness ruins, or the tunnel.

name: Give Surok the infused wand and bowl

evidence.note: Receive Surok's letter for Rat.

name: Report Surok's plans to Rat Burgiss

evidence.note: Rat asks you to find Zaff.

name: Ask Zaff for the beacon ring

evidence.note: Bring the ring to the palace to summon Zaff at the right time.

name: Subdue King Roald and operate the beacon ring

evidence.note: Bring Roald to 1 Hitpoint and operate the ring to summon Zaff.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Reduce King Roald to 1 Hitpoint and successfully summon Zaff.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow extra time and bring suitable gear and food.

name: Report the rescue to Rat Burgiss

evidence.note: Receive 1 quest point, 8,000 Runecraft XP and 2,000 Defence XP. Keep the beacon ring.

name: Excavate the Chaos shortcut at the statue

evidence.note: Ask Anna about the statue, show her the books and use the bronze pickaxe she provides to excavate the statue.

name: Take Dagon'hai history from the Varrock library

evidence.note: Search the palace library bookcase for the history. It is used for the tunnel and later museum report.

name: Show Dagon'hai history to Historian Minas

evidence.note: The upstairs report credits five museum kudos and carries no XP lamp.

name: Ask Osman about sq'irkjuice

evidence.note: After the rescue, ask Osman about the Sorceress and her sq'irkjuice.
